step input

  • CURIE: gmeow:stepInput
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/stepInput
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/procedures

An entity consumed by a procedure step — a dataset, ingredient, document, tool, or any other resource. Range is owl:Thing to admit any input type. Non-functional: a step may have multiple inputs, and competing input claims coexist (Principle 9).

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:ProcedureStep -> owl:Thing

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:stepInput from gmeow:ProcedureStep to owl:Thing when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:ProcedureStep
